summary: Firecrawl’s Student Program gives verified students a one-time grant of 10,000 free credits for educational or personal projects, not 10,000 credits every month. Use a valid institution-issued academic email as your Firecrawl account email and redeem STUDENTEDU in Settings → Billing; no card is required. The page broadly lists college, university or accredited educational programs; its high-school/bootcamp FAQ directs bootcamp, accredited-program and high-school computer-science applicants to email for case-by-case review. If a side project becomes a paid/startup project, the FAQ directs users to upgrade and contact its partner programs. This grant is separate from the ongoing free plan.
claim_steps: Sign up for Firecrawl with your educational email address.
Go to Settings → Billing and enter the student coupon code shown on the program page.
Receive the one-time 10,000-credit student grant instantly; no credit card is required. It is not a monthly student allowance.
High-school, bootcamp and other accredited-program applicants should email Firecrawl for case-by-case review rather than assume automatic eligibility.

social_proof.title: Firecrawl Student Program
social_proof.text: Verified students get 10,000 free credits. Build real projects with the same API trusted by Apple, Canva, and Lovable.
